name: ascend
description: ASCEND: an offline desktop fitness RPG (Electron + React + FastAPI sidecar)
author: The ASCEND team

scripts.build:sidecar: cd services/sidecar && uv sync --frozen --group build && uv run --group build pyinstaller packaging/ascend-sidecar.spec --noconfirm
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:sidecar && npm run dist:win -w apps/desktop
